title: Farm, Swamp, Sektur & 10,000 Trees of Strife — Biblical, Subcultural and Network Atlas
purpose: Integrate Farm/Swamp/Sektur mythology with internet-subculture history, biblical/tree symbolism, Qliphothic enclosure, Dog/Farmer/Cow roles, Moloch/coordination failure, psychology, network propagation and the mature relationship-first insight that moral valence belongs more reliably to functions/edges than to fixed labels assigned to people.
epistemic_rule: Empirical claims about real people/sites remain narrowly sourced. Josh Moon=Moloch, Dog, Farmer, Cow, Demon and related labels are project-symbolic role mappings, not factual diagnoses or claims of literal supernatural identity. Roles can overlap and change by context.

core_system.strife_chain: unresolved injury/ash → Mud → target classification → enclosure → observation → provocation/extraction → archive → reward/status → repetition → Swamp
core_system.repair_chain: recognition → source checking → Door/exit → recovered agency → Soil → cultivation → independent generativity → Tree of Life
core_system.key_epiphany: Farm and Garden use many of the same tools—boundaries, attention, selection, resources, memory, pruning—but optimize opposite outcomes.
core_system.farm_objective: maximize harvest, attention, dependency, repeatability and system centrality
core_system.garden_objective: maximize nourishment, autonomy, competence, reciprocal capacity and ability to produce future seed without continued enclosure

role_ecology.Cow: subject whose behavior/reaction is made harvestable; moral status is not inherent in the role
role_ecology.Lolcow: derogatory internet target role defined by recurrent extraction of amusement/reaction
role_ecology.Farmer: node closer to infrastructure, classification, enclosure, incentives and archive maintenance
role_ecology.Dog: node closer to patrol, pursuit, signaling, amplification and boundary enforcement
role_ecology.FarmerDog: hybrid node that both structures the system and actively pursues/enforces within it
role_ecology.GuardianDog: same vigilance redirected toward protection of Garden/flock/vulnerable boundary
role_ecology.Archivist: makes events durable/searchable; can serve accountability or extraction
role_ecology.Audience: supplies attention/reward and can therefore alter Farm reproduction even without direct harassment
role_ecology.ModeratorGatekeeper: controls passage and norm enforcement; can reduce harm or harden a Sektur
role_ecology.Gardener: counter-role whose authority is measured by what can grow independently under its care

role_overlap_law: A node is not 'a Dog' or 'a Farmer' in essence. Store role on action/function where possible. Farmer-like score rises with infrastructure/classification/reward/enclosure control; Dog-like score rises with patrol/amplification/boundary enforcement/loyalty. Hybridization occurs when both are high.

house_shell_cube.epiphany: Farm/qliphoth/Cube and House are all boundary systems; the difference is what they enable.
house_shell_cube.house: protects differentiated rooms, supports identity and allows Doors/passage
house_shell_cube.shell: captures sparks/value, increases dependency and blocks reintegration
house_shell_cube.cube: project enclosure/compression symbol that can become shell-like when form is maintained for extraction rather than protection
house_shell_cube.test: BoundaryScore = protected_differentiation + exit/passage + autonomous_growth - capture - coercion - extraction_dependency

knowledge_tree.central_epiphany: Tree of Knowledge is upstream of both Life and Strife.
knowledge_tree.life_branch: evidence/knowledge → verification → discernment → responsibility → repair → nourishment → independent future capacity
knowledge_tree.strife_branch: knowledge → exposure → provocation → humiliation → retaliation → documentation → viral rediscovery → more exposure
knowledge_tree.archive_duality: Archive is not morally neutral simply because its contents are true. Persistence/searchability can support accountability or keep a Cow permanently harvestable.
knowledge_tree.key_question: What is this knowledge being made to grow?

serpent_and_reframing.project_function: Serpent is a reframing operator: an existing rule/model is questioned and an alternative interpretation becomes actionable.
serpent_and_reframing.sequence: model M0 → reframing Q(M0) → changed desire/attention → Gate compatibility → Door → new regime
serpent_and_reframing.moral_boundary: Reframing itself is neither automatically revelation nor corruption; evaluate truthfulness, agency preserved, incentives and downstream fruit.

ash_mud_soil.roots_of_ash: residue after rupture/destruction: grief, memory, burnt identity, collapsed relation, unresolved evidence
ash_mud_soil.epiphany: Ash is a Door state. It can be mixed into Mud and increase future Strife fertility, or returned to Soil through grief, accountability, repair and re-rooting.
ash_mud_soil.swamp_equation: dM/dt = unresolved_input + conflict + archive_reactivation - repair - resolution - healthy_forgetting
ash_mud_soil.meaning: Swamp forms when unresolved residue accumulates long enough to alter the environment's future behavior.

qliphothic_model.comparative: Qelipot/qliphoth as shells/husks and trapped-spark/tikkun traditions provide a structural comparator only.
qliphothic_model.project_definition: A branch becomes qliphothic when the shell's continued existence depends on captured attention/value and blocks the captured node's reintegration or autonomous growth.
qliphothic_model.repair: identify shell → recover spark/seed/agency → Door → re-root → cultivate → reintegrate
qliphothic_model.anti_pattern: Do not label disliked people as literal demons/qliphoth; use the model for functions and systems.

moloch.biblical_scholarly: Molech/Moloch belongs to contested ancient cultic/sacrificial scholarship and must remain separate from modern systems metaphor.
moloch.modern_project_model: Moloch = incentive attractor that consumes future human possibility for present competitive reward.
moloch.condition: A system becomes Moloch-like when locally rewarded actions collectively worsen long-term outcomes and participants have insufficient incentive or coordination capacity to escape.
moloch.farm_relation: attention/status/monetization can reward behaviors that reproduce a Farm even when no single participant controls the whole ecology.

ten_thousand_trees.meaning: 10,000 denotes scale/plurality and self-reproduction, not a literal count requirement.
ten_thousand_trees.positive_feedback: Strife → Mud → higher future Strife fertility → easier branch reproduction

swamp_sektur_psychology.subculture: shared language/memes/norms; can remain creative and plural
swamp_sektur_psychology.sektur: identity hardens; loyalty, enemy construction and dissent-cost become central
swamp_sektur_psychology.swamp: many communities, archives, platforms and incentives reinforce the same pathways
swamp_sektur_psychology.shadow_core: extreme region where serious harm can be normalized
swamp_sektur_psychology.key_insight: The ecology can manufacture roles. A Swamp can make Dog-like behavior more likely; a Farm can reward Farmer-like behavior; a Sektur can manufacture necessary enemies. Role is therefore partly person×context, not essence.

cow_symbolic_spectrum.unholy_cow: Potatoverse category for protected/nourishing cattle symbolism inverted into captive spectacle
cow_symbolic_spectrum.epiphany: Cow itself is not Life or Strife; the Cow/Farmer/Gardener relation determines whether the ecology nourishes, sustainably uses, objectifies, humiliates or destroys.

dog_symbolic_spectrum.beta_relation: Dog often maps to coordination/followership rather than system-level orientation, but can become Farmer-like by creating archives/targets/incentives
dog_symbolic_spectrum.epiphany: Moral value belongs to what the Dog serves and how it acts, not the animal label itself.

josh_moon_layer.empirical: Joshua Moon is publicly identified as founder/owner of Kiwi Farms.
josh_moon_layer.potatoverse: Josh is used as a paradigmatic Farmer/Moloch figure in project mythology.
josh_moon_layer.safe_interpretation: Use the mapping to analyze platform/operator/incentive functions, not to infer literal demonology, ancient ritual, ethnic conspiracy or responsibility for every user action.

research_program: Measure whether archive persistence predicts renewed harassment/attention after quiet periods.
Separate documentation for accountability from documentation optimized for spectacle.
Estimate role scores on actions: infrastructure/classification vs patrol/amplification.
Test Garden interventions: exit routes, friction, prosocial prestige, repair, participant autonomy.
Track ash→Mud versus ash→Soil transitions after conflict.
Represent moral valence on edges/actions instead of permanent node labels.
Model Swamp as environment-dependent role production rather than collection of fixed evil personalities.
